summary: Public web builds compare the private changelog directory using the same canonical path identity as bundled modules, so symlink spellings cannot evade the private-module boundary.

replay.detail: No runtime state or claims change.

schema.detail: No wire or stored format change.

rules.detail: The existing public-build privacy policy is unchanged. Its module check now recognizes canonical symlink targets before checking emitted private text.

compatibility.detail: Public builds with a private module in their graph are correctly refused when a registry directory uses a symlink spelling, including platform temporary-directory aliases.

recovery.detail: Remove the private import from the public build. The content marker guard remains in place independently.
